subject: Temporary evidence escrow & SSO proof request — Ava Solutions
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@avasolutions.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary evidence escrow & SSO proof request

Hi Rishi / Marissa —

Thanks for the sync last week. Per our procurement team, were ready to push a compact evidence bundle to get initial whitelisting for our integration. We can upload to Whistic (preferred) or Vendr if you require API ingestion.

Request: can Redwood accept a "compact binder" for onboarding (SOC2 summary + SSO screenshots + KMS attestation) and grant a short presigned upload window for additional artifacts? Wed like to avoid the full SIG up front; team is prepared to complete SIG within 90 days.

Attachments: ava_compact_binder_v1.zip (contains manifest, soc2-summary-2027.pdf, sso screenshots).

Notes: the integration is limited to our public REST API (no customer data persist beyond ephemeral tokens). For SSO proof well include the service account metadata and SAML EntityID.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to run through constraints.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Security Program Manager
Ava Solutions
security@avasolutions.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary evidence escrow & SSO proof request

Hi Sarah —

Thanks, this looks reasonable for an initial onboarding path. A few quick clarifications before we approve the presign window: 

- Which portal will you upload to? Whistic preferred; if Vendr well need API key + contact.
- For the compact binder wed need: (1) SOC2 summary (one page), (2) SSO config screenshots showing SAML metadata & EntityID, and (3) KMS attestation or equivalent statement of key custody.
- We can grant a 72-hour presign window for uploads; please advise target start date.
- Note: well accept compact evidence for initial whitelisting but require completion of SIG/SLA questionnaire within 90 days.

Looping in Jordan and Marissa to confirm upload choreography and to raise a short ticket for tracking.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@avasolutions.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary evidence escrow & SSO proof request

Thanks for flagging — a few technical ops items: 

- Whistic upload is easiest. If they must use Vendr, well need an API contact and well generate a scoped API key limited to file ingestion.
- Presign guidance: 72-hour S3 presign window works. Well provide a short-lived presign link to a dedicated intake bucket (no public ACLs).
- For SSO proof we need the service account name + SAML EntityID and at least one IdP metadata screenshot (including assertionConsumerService URL).
- Please include a manifest.txt in the zip listing filenames and short hashes (md5/sha256) so we can validate on ingest.

Ill open the intake bucket and share presign details once Marissa signs off.

Jordan
Onboarding Engineer, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@avasolutions.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary evidence escrow & SSO proof request

Approved for an exception to accept the compact binder as an interim onboarding artifact. Conditions: 

- Compact binder accepted for initial whitelisting only. Full SIG (or equivalent CAIQ) must be completed within 90 days; add to ticket for follow-up.
- Preservation: Ava must confirm retention policy for uploaded artifacts and provide an audit contact for future evidence rotation.
- Evidence custody: well store the artifacts in our intake bucket for 12 months unless retention agreement is changed.

Action items for Rishi / Jordan: please generate the presign link + intake bucket ACLs and raise Jira SEC-5421 to track the SIG completion deadline. Sarah: please confirm preferred start date for presign window; Jordan recommends starting 72-hour window on July 12 to align with their procurement timeline.

Thanks — confirmed. We will upload to Whistic and schedule the upload to begin on Fri, 12 Jul 2028; please send the presign link when ready. I attached the two files we can share immediately (soc2-summary-2027.pdf and ava_sso_config_screenshots.pdf) for your intake team to pre-check.
